ambient campaign context (set/clear/active_campaign) stamps every runtime auto-record

recent_activity_view (cold-landing newest-window journal read) + group_history campaign= narrowing (the WHERE x WHEN join) + impact_view composition lift (every radius names the current subsystems it touches)

edges_authored.why: MutationResearch installs and cleans one active root configuration instance.
MutationResearch owns the research-set registry (guaranteed default set) and cascades cleanup into every set.

MutationResearch is the package's only crystallizer touchpoint: it emits MutationResearchCrystal composition twins and RecordedUnitState flips into the passive sink, and its foresight reads consume get_spell_crystal / analyze_impact as read-only custody facades. The emitted MutationResearchCrystal derives EXPLICIT DB-storable node rows for BOTH families (research_nodes / grouped_research_nodes) from the composition at construction - blob and objects cannot disagree.
MutationResearch lazily owns one DiffEngine behind diff_research and cascades cleanup into it.
create_diff_engine mints detached caller-owned engines over the same custody-backed material resolver.
The root lazily constructs and owns one synthesizer for synthesize_candidate; cleanup cascades.
synthesize_candidate births the synthesizer on first use (DiffEngine precedent).
The root lazily owns one grouped engine for group_diff_research; cleanup cascades.
group_diff_research births the engine on first use over _resolve_group_material (roster + lane joins).
